title: Phase-end Pi compaction bridge
statement: After a Cartographer implementation phase writes its state snapshot and resume context, the workflow must be able to trigger actual Pi context compaction through the Pi harness rather than only updating .cartographer state.

title: Explicit compaction tool reports queued/skipped/unavailable outcome
Proactive context threshold compaction
statement: During active Cartographer implementation, the extension should detect context usage crossing a configurable threshold, defaulting near 60 percent, and request actual Pi compaction outside mutable tool execution.

title: Threshold crossing queues one compaction request
Threshold hook uses usage percent and duplicate-trigger guard
Additive Cartographer summary focus
statement: The compaction bridge must preserve Pi's default summarizer by default while adding customInstructions that retain bounded Cartographer resume context and continue-with-implement-skill guidance.

title: Compaction prompt carries bounded resume state
Custom instructions mention state-resume and implement skill continuation
Safe configuration and observability
statement: The compaction bridge must be configurable or disableable, avoid compaction loops, and expose compact outcomes without storing raw transcript summaries in plan artifacts.

title: Unavailable Pi context is reported as safe skip
Recent compaction request suppresses duplicate trigger
